description: Find current coupon codes and deals (offers without a code, e.g. free shipping) by keyword and/or store name, optionally for one country. A keyword also matches store names, so "vpn" finds NordVPN. Returns up to 10 active offers (at most 3 per store unless a store is given) with code (or none), end date, countries and links, and says when there are more. Covers coupon codes and deals, not individual products on sale.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

name: search_coupons
title: Search coupon codes and deals
